At the clique root z, the exact signs \(F_L(z)=\alpha\beta(z-1)/(z-\alpha)<0\) and \(F_H(z)=\alpha(1-z)/(z-\alpha)>0\) imply the strict ranking, with no numerical assumptions. Implicit differentiation and q-to-infinity root limits yield the stated asymptotics. check.py reproduces 21,516 supporting exact-arithmetic/numerical assertions and independent full-matrix eigenvalue comparisons. Finite computations are supplementary, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The parameter-free strict ranking is a complete, natural topology-and-damage-location classification over all star network sizes and all positive migration and mortality intensities. It converts the known qualitative warning that corridor addition may be detrimental into an exact two-sided network management criterion and provides weak/strong damage laws; this is not an arbitrary numerical slice or a small parameter adjustment. Caveat: it is a clean linear benchmark, not a real-world extinction prediction.
